purpose: REVIEWER ONLY. Contains later-event calendar knowledge and outcome tripwires. Never provide this file or search evidence to report writers.
cutoff_rule: Each report uses information strictly before report-date 00:00:00 UTC. First eligible means first weekday report whose cutoff is later than release.
access_limit: Official-origin hosts are not on the enforced allowlist. Only approved news.google.com historical RSS/index metadata was fetched. No original-body or original-vintage verification is claimed. Failed searches retained in release_search_evidence.json.
schedule_limit: Precise UTC values below are schedule-derived reference times, not fetched original publication timestamps. Calendar candidates without usable index evidence require corroboration; review disputed close-midnight cases manually.
nominal_index_caution: 07:00/08:00UTC RSS dates are frequently nominal. Several China stories are indexed on previous UTC calendar day despite next-day China release; Japan 08:30/08:50 JST genuinely falls on previous UTC evening.
asx_premarket_caution: An ASX company release at 07:00/08:00 AEST is 21:00/22:00 UTC on previous day; do not automatically shift it to next report. No specific September ASX premarket event was corroborated here.
